description: Source code for Wi-Fi configuration management in prplMesh, including functions to get/set Wi-Fi interfaces, credentials, and paths, specific to Linux platform.

methods.name: cfg_get_all_prplmesh_wifi_interfaces
methods.description: Retrieves all Wi-Fi interfaces for prplMesh, populating provided array and count.

methods.name: cfg_get_wifi_params
methods.description: Initializes Wi-Fi parameters with default values for a given interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_wireless_settings
methods.description: Collects wireless BSS info configurations for all interfaces.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_wifi_credentials
methods.description: Reads Wi-Fi credentials from configuration for a specific interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_set_wifi_credentials
methods.description: Sets Wi-Fi credentials into configuration for a specific interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_wpa_supplicant_ctrl_path
methods.description: Retrieves WPA supplicant control path for an interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_hostapd_ctrl_path
methods.description: Retrieves hostapd control path for an interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_mandatory_interfaces
methods.description: Retrieves mandatory interfaces (not used in Linux implementation).

methods.name: cfg_get_sta_iface
methods.description: Gets station interface name based on configuration.

methods.name: cfg_get_hostap_iface
methods.description: Gets hostap interface name for a given radio number.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_monitored_BSSs_by_radio_iface
methods.description: Retrieves monitored BSSs for a radio interface (stub implementation).
